_comment: Cape Codder announcements. Edit this file to change what shows on the site — no code, no rebuild. Newest first is not required; the site sorts by date automatically, and any entry with pinned:true is floated to the top. Delete the sample entries below before launch.

_fields.id: Unique short string. Used for the anchor link, so keep it stable once published.
_fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD. Shown to visitors and used for sorting.
_fields.tag: Short label on the card. Suggested: News, Hiring, Schedule, Offer, Storm, Award.
_fields.title: One line. This is what people scan — keep it under about 70 characters.
_fields.body: One to three short paragraphs. Separate paragraphs with a blank line (\n\n).
_fields.pinned: true floats this entry to the top regardless of date. Optional, defaults to false.
_fields.expires: YYYY-MM-DD. Optional. The entry hides itself after this date — good for limited offers.
_fields.link: Optional { text, href }. Renders as a button under the body.

announcements.title: SAMPLE — Booking exterior work for autumn 2026
announcements.body:
This is a sample entry so you can see the layout. Replace the text with a real announcement, or delete the entry entirely.

Anything you write here shows up on the site the moment you save the file. Two or three sentences reads best.
